context_requirements: Expression of neuropeptide receptors (NPY1R/NPY2R/NPY5R or bombesin/GRP receptor) or MCOLN3
Autocrine or paracrine neuropeptide growth signaling driving basal proliferation
Intact apoptotic machinery; Bcl-2 overexpression may not block this apoptosis
Capacity to generate reactive oxygen species and/or low glutathione buffering
falsifiers: No change in AP-1 target genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
No apoptosis or oxidative-stress signature at 24 h in any line
Strong and consistent responses in all nine lines, including HA1E and HEP2, which would suggest a non-specific mechanism

evidence.supports: Broad-spectrum neuropeptide receptor antagonist induces apoptosis selectively in SCLC cells expressing gastrin-releasing peptide receptor, independent of Bcl-2
Neuropeptide receptor antagonist inhibits neuropeptide-stimulated tyrosine phosphorylation and PTK activity, inhibits SCLC growth, and increases apoptosis
Antagonist G stimulates JNK, AP-1 transcription, ROS generation, glutathione reduction, ceramide production, and sensitizes SCLC cells to chemotherapy
